v: tri॰ subantasya ekasya vIpsArTe dvitvam “ekaM bahubrIhivat” pA॰ dvirukta ekaSabdo bahubrIhivat tena sublopapuMvatBAvO । pratyekapadArTe iha dvayorapi supoluki kfte sati bahubrIhivadBAvAdeva prAtipAdakatvAt samudAyAt punaH sup । striyAM wAp । ekEkA AhutiH । “na bahubrIhO” pA॰ sarvanAmasaMjYAnizeDaH muKyabahuvrIhiparastena ekEkasmE ekEkasmAt ityAdO sarvvanAmakAryyam । “daSa daSa vA ekEkasmin prARAH” Sa॰ brA॰ 8, 1, 1, 2 । tataH kArakArTe Sas । ekEkaSas kArakarUpapratyeke avya॰ । “ekEkaSaScaret kfcCraM dvijaH pApApanuttaye” prA॰ ta॰ viSvA॰ “brAhmaRasya kzayAhasya yat pramARaM samAsataH । erkakaSoyugAnAM tu kramaSastAn niboData” manuH । svArTe yat । ekEkaSya tadarTe na॰ “ekEkaSyenAnupUrvyA BUtvA BUtveha rjAyate” BA॰ 7, 15, 42 “ekEkaSyaM tadA yoDA DArttarAzwrasya BArata । paryyavarttanta ganDarvErdaSaBirdaSaBiH saha” BA॰ va॰ । 240 । nIlakaRWena “ekEkasyeti paWitvA ekEkamiti vyAKyAtam” ekEkaSo BAvaH yat । ekEkaSya “ekEkarASiBavane “ekEkaSyena yaTAnupUrvyam” BAga॰ 5, 1, 35 ।
m: एकैक mfn. one by one, single, every single one, AV. iii, 28, 1; ŚBr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.
एकैक—शस् ind. one by one, severally, seriatim, Suśr.; Mn. &c.
एकैकश्य n. single state, severalty, MBh.
एकैकम् (अम्), ind. singly, one by one, R. &c.
एकैक—तर mfn. one by one (out of many), BhP.
एकैक—वत् mfn. possessing (only) one (of several things), ib.
एकैक—वृत्ति mfn. existing in only one object, Bhāṣāp.
